title: sitemap.xml and robots.txt

requirements.text: sitemap.xml lists absolute, XML-escaped URLs with validated lastmod, changefreq and priority
Sites beyond 50,000 URLs (or 50 MB) are split into several sitemaps under a sitemap index
robots.txt has per-user-agent allow/disallow rules and references the sitemap by absolute URL
Rule values containing newlines or invalid paths are refused, so directives cannot be injected
Only public, canonical, indexable pages are listed; private, tenant-only and noindex pages are excluded
Both files are served at the site root with the right content type, and non-production environments disallow crawling
